stem: Which group does NOT belong with the others?
hints: Check whether the letters in each group come one right after another in the alphabet.
C, D, E come one after another. Check the other groups the same way.
Three groups use 3 letters in a row with no gaps. Find the group that skips a letter.

solution.methodName: Find the rule three of them share

steps.action: Check CDE: C, D, E come one after another. No letter is skipped.
steps.why: In odd-one-out items, look for a rule that three choices share and one breaks.

steps.action: Check RST and NOP: R, S, T and N, O, P also come one after another.
Check JKM: J, K, then L is skipped before M.
steps.why: J = 10, K = 11, M = 13. The jump from 11 to 13 is 2, not 1.

steps.action: Three groups follow the rule "three letters in a row". JKM breaks it. The answer is JKM.

trapNotes.CDE: C, D, E come one right after another (3, 4, 5), so CDE follows the rule.
trapNotes.RST: RST may look odd because its letters are near the end of the alphabet, but where a group sits does not matter. R, S, T come one after another (18, 19, 20), so it follows the rule.
trapNotes.NOP: NOP may stand out because it holds the vowel O, but CDE also has a vowel (E). N, O, P come one after another (14, 15, 16), so it follows the rule.
